channel.title: Kontaro Blog: WhatsApp for Small Business
channel.description: Practical guides for small businesses on WhatsApp customer service, sales, campaigns and AI. Written for owners, not developers.

item.title: How to answer customers on WhatsApp faster (without hiring anyone)
item.dc:creator: Lucas Vaz
item.description: Practical ways for small businesses to cut WhatsApp reply times: shared inbox, quick replies, after-hours AI and a simple routine your team can keep.

item.title: How to use AI on WhatsApp without sounding like a robot
item.dc:creator: Lucas Vaz
item.description: Set up an AI assistant for WhatsApp that sounds like your business: what to teach it, how to set its tone and when it must hand the chat to a person.

item.title: The WhatsApp 24-hour window, explained in plain English
item.dc:creator: Lucas Vaz
item.description: What the WhatsApp customer service window is, what you can send inside and outside it, how templates work and how it affects what you pay.

item.title: WhatsApp Business App vs. API: which one does your business need?
item.dc:creator: Lucas Vaz
item.description: A plain comparison of the free WhatsApp Business app and the WhatsApp Business Platform (API): team access, automation, campaigns, costs and when to switch.

item.title: How to turn WhatsApp conversations into sales: a simple follow-up routine
item.dc:creator: Lucas Vaz
item.description: A practical follow-up routine for small businesses that sell on WhatsApp: track every lead, set a next step, follow up at the right time and close more sales.

item.title: WhatsApp marketing messages that don't get you blocked
item.dc:creator: Lucas Vaz
item.description: How to send WhatsApp campaigns customers welcome: opt-in, segments, good templates, timing and frequency, plus what gets numbers flagged or limited.
